newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Gov. Miller appoints revenue commissioner.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Gov. Miller appoints revenue commissioner.

text.p: Georgia Gov. Zell Miller has appointed Acting Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson as the permanent commissioner.
Jackson joined the Department of Revennue in 1979 as deputy commissioner and has the "experience and judgment" needed to modernize the department, Miller said in a prepared statement.
Jackson had been acting commissioner since Commissioner Marcus Collins retired in September amid allegations of lax administration.
The state auditor said in June that the agency had lost track of $1.5 billion of sales tax revenues and had guessed how much to return to municipalities, overpaying some and underpaying others.
The problems were blamed in part on outdated computer equipment.
